claim_not_identified: anonymous activity rows do not identify the effective graph with the anatomical C. elegans connectome
claim_tested: a sparse train-only directed effective graph adds held-out neural-state prediction beyond local history, symmetric diffusion, and node-permuted graphs

equations.diffusion: x_i[t+h] = f_i(local) + b_i^T sum_j a_ij (x_j[t:t-2] - x_i[t:t-2]) + error
equations.directed: x_i[t+h] = f_i(local) + c_i^T sum_j w_ij x_j[t:t-2] + error

graph_policy.diffusion_edges: symmetric non-negative top-k absolute activity correlations in the training block
graph_policy.directed_edges: top-k signed correlations between source state and one-step local innovation in the training block
graph_policy.multi_horizon_rule: the directed adjacency is always learned at h=1 and reused for the requested evaluation horizon
graph_policy.null: node permutation P A P^T preserves learned weights and degree distribution while breaking alignment to recorded units

result.replicate_unit: independently recorded animal, never target unit

split_policy: chronological 60/20/20 with embargo; imputation, scaling, adjacency, and ridge selection never inspect the test block
